question: Show Head and Neck PD-L1, CTLA-4 trials conducted in 2018 or later.
pred_sql: SELECT "nct", "author", "year", "pubmed_id" FROM public."clinical_trials" WHERE "cancer_type" ILIKE '%head and neck%' AND "class_of_ici" ILIKE '%PD1%' OR "class_of_ici" ILIKE '%CTLA4%' AND "year" >= 2018;
